optimized_sql:
WITH date_dim_filter AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE (d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2))
),
household_demographics_filter AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND CASE WHEN hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN hd_dep_count / hd_vehicle_count ELSE NULL END > 1
),
dj AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number,
           ss.ss_customer_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim_filter dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN store st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN household_demographics_filter hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE st.s_county IN ('Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County','Williamson County')
    GROUP BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
)
SELECT c.c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt
FROM dj
JOIN customer c ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC
